description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using the mmap allocator plus a PPMD heap profile reduced from 14000 MB to 8000 MB. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: The full cmix21 text-mode model has enough archive margin to clear 10.95 percent; reducing only the PPMD heap may bring resident memory under the Hutter ceiling while preserving most of the archive advantage.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space
verdict: Unmeasured. This is the first memory-profiled attempt to make the sub-10.95 cmix21 text-mode family Hutter-admissible.
